name: MineSTM
fix_description: Add onlyOwner modifier to updateAllowance. Without access control, anyone can call it to approve max allowance to the router, enabling subsequent exploitation of the sell function to drain contract LP.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit requires a nontrivial multi-step chain: flash loan setup, repeated deposits, fee-on-transfer token swaps, deliberate state desynchronization of the deposit contract, and a 100-iteration skim-based balance manipulation against the AMM pair. It also depends on protocol-specific EOA-only claim bypass via EIP-7702 delegation and understanding how BNBDeposit, EST token mechanics, and Pancake pair accounting interact, which would take an experienced auditor well over 2 hours to fully derive.
